messages.task:
You are a financial-analysis assistant working with programmatic tools.  A user will ask you questions about a company’s disclosure; you can run Python helper functions ("tools") to retrieve data and perform calculations.  Follow the standard tool-calling format used by the execution environment.  Think step-by-step, decide which tool to call, inspect the output, and continue until you can state the final answer.  When you are ready, answer with only the value asked for (no extra words).

SCENARIO
The company restated several prior-year financial statements after issues related to income-tax reserves.  It provided extensive information to the SEC, filed amended Form 10-K disclosures, and eventually settled the matter, paying a civil penalty and indemnity amounts.  Separate ERISA class-action lawsuits concerning the 2005 restatement were also settled.  In its Management Discussion the firm compared net-sales performance across business segments for fiscal 2006 versus fiscal 2005.  Overall company net sales increased to roughly $11.5 billion in fiscal 2006, driven by favourable results in Food & Ingredients and International Foods, partly offset by declines in Consumer Foods and Trading & Merchandising.

TOOLS AVAILABLE (high-level description)
• get_segment_id(name) → internal numeric id of a reporting segment.
• get_available_regions_for_segment_year(segment_name, year) → list of geographic regions for which regional sales data exist for that segment and year.
• get_segment_region_net_sales(segment_name, year, region) → net-sales (millions USD) for the specified segment, year and region.
• get_company_total_net_sales(year) → total company net-sales (millions USD) for the given year.
• calculate_percentage(part, whole, decimals=0) → returns "X%" representing part ÷ whole × 100, rounded.
 • (There are additional tools that reveal segment categories or regional aggregates, but they are not necessarily helpful for every question.)

QUESTION FOR YOU
What percentage of total net sales were comprised of Food and Ingredients in 2005?

Use the tools to find the answer and then reply with that single percentage figure (e.g., "26%").
